facts.text: Bruges' historic center is compact and best explored entirely on foot; it is not designed for cars and traffic is heavily restricted.
Bruges is extremely popular with day-trippers from Brussels; the center is noticeably calmer before 10am and after 6pm when tour groups have left.
Chocolate shops immediately around Markt square are priced at a premium versus shops a few streets away selling comparable quality.
A canal boat tour is a classic activity (~€12-14 per person, ~30 minutes) and generally considered worth it for first-time visitors.
Climbing the Belfry tower (366 steps) offers the best panoramic view of the city but has limited capacity and can involve a wait in peak season.
